model_notes.goals: Score markets are derived from one normalized Dixon-Coles Poisson grid.
model_notes.winner: Every match names the most likely result. Confidence reflects the gap between the two most likely outcomes; close calls are flagged low confidence.
model_notes.margin: Winning margin is the most likely exact margin given the predicted result; the scoreline is the most likely exact score with that result and margin.
model_notes.timing: Halves use validated halftime scores with league shrinkage; optional 15-minute windows stay league-wide until the 3,000-goal threshold and never predict an exact minute.
